name: fred_economic_data
description: Retrieves key US macroeconomic series (Federal Funds Rate, CPI, GDP, Unemployment Rate, etc.) from the Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) API, returning recent observations with series metadata.

series_id.description: FRED series ID (e.g. FEDFUNDS, CPIAUCSL, GDP, UNRATE)

limit.description: Number of most recent data points to return

api_key.description: FRED API key; falls back to FRED_API_KEY environment variable
